title: Bug: paginate() returns the wrong slice for the last page and total_pages() over-counts
body:
## Bug Report
**File:** `src/pagination.py`

`paginate(items, page, size)` computes `start = page * size` but ends at `start + size - 1`, silently dropping the last item of every page. `total_pages()` uses integer division without rounding up, so 10 items with page size 4 report 2 pages instead of 3.
### Expected
- page 2 of [0..9] with size 4 is [4,5,6,7]
- `total_pages(10, 4) == 3`
